defectDescription: Compiler regex matches on "this spirit can't block" and emits unconditional SET_RESTRICTION CANNOT_BLOCK on self, dropping the relative BP filter ("Spirits with BP inferior to this Spirit's").
recommendedCorrectionArea: Update clause_patterns.js:844 to parse relative BP comparison filters and emit conditional block restrictions instead of unconditional CANNOT_BLOCK.

defectDescription: Target selection or removal operation (DESTROY/BOUNCE/TARGET) completely omits relative comparison constraints ("with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's", "with cost equal or inferior to that Spirit's", etc.).
recommendedCorrectionArea: Extend target selector parsing to capture relative comparison operands (comparison: INFERIOR_OR_EQUAL, compareWith: SELF_BP/TARGET_COST).

defectDescription: When "once per turn" is written as a sentence ("You can only use [Keyword] once per turn", "can only attack once per turn"), header_parser fails to extract it into header.limit, leaving the effect repeatable.
recommendedCorrectionArea: Enhance header_parser.js and clause_splitter.js to detect sentence-level once-per-turn declarations and bind them to ability header.limit.

defectDescription: Loose regex matching on "can't be", "can't attack", or "can't block" emits an empty op { op: "COMBAT_RESTRICTION" } lacking target, condition, duration, or restriction mechanics.
recommendedCorrectionArea: Replace generic fallback with structured combat restriction models, or categorize clauses as unhandled with specific mechanics.

defectDescription: Matches complex combat mechanics ("compare lv instead of bp", "must block with", "can target and attack") and emits unparameterized { op: "COMBAT_RULE" } without operands or executable semantics.
recommendedCorrectionArea: Define specialized combat rule operations (e.g. COMPARE_LV_OVERRIDE, REDIRECT_ATTACK_TARGET) with explicit parameters.

defectDescription: Phrases granting conditional destruction immunity (e.g., "can't be destroyed by opposing effects", "can't be destroyed by BP comparison") match a broad regex emitting unconditional INDESTRUCTIBLE, rendering the card immune to ALL forms of destruction.
recommendedCorrectionArea: Parse specific destruction causes (BP_COMPARISON, OPPOSING_EFFECTS, SPIRIT_EFFECTS) into indestructible.by array.

defectDescription: Clause splitter regex strips "(This effect can't bring the number of cores on the opposing Spirit down to 0.)", allowing MOVE_CORE to completely deplete cores and illegally destroy spirits by core exhaustion.
recommendedCorrectionArea: Preserve zero-depletion restriction as a cannotZero: true flag on the emitted MOVE_CORE operation.

defectDescription: Target selection text specifying target with "highest BP", "lowest BP", or "highest cost" emits a target selector omitting the extreme comparison constraint, permitting arbitrary target choices.
recommendedCorrectionArea: Extract extreme constraints into target.selector: { filter: "EXTREME_BP", order: "HIGHEST" / "LOWEST" }.

defectDescription: Phrases establishing conditional prerequisite dependency ("When you've done so,", "If you do,") are not captured into clause.link, allowing secondary operations to execute even if the cost/prerequisite failed.
recommendedCorrectionArea: Ensure clause connector regex reliably captures all variations of prerequisite dependency and sets link: "ifYouDo".

defectDescription: Non-combat restriction clauses like "(This effect can't be used while on the Field.)" or "cannot be activated" match the loose /can't be/ regex and emit COMBAT_RESTRICTION instead of PLAY_RESTRICTION / ACTIVATION_GATING.
recommendedCorrectionArea: Add higher-precedence pattern for effect activation restrictions before loose /can't be/ combat regex.
